senses.gloss:
mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Respected, honoured.
f. (-ता)
Cumin.
E.
दृ to respect, affix क्त.

m. (-तिः)
1 A bellows.
2 A fish.
3 A skin of leather, or a leather bag for holding water.
4 Skin, hide.
E.
दॄ to divide, क्तिन् aff.

m. (-कः)
A plant, commonly Acanpāta.
E.
दृति a bellows, and धारक having; having leaves compared to a leather bellows.

m. (-रिः)
A dog.
E.
दृति here said to mean skin in general, and हरि who steals, from हृ with इन् aff.

m. (-रः)
A carrier of skins or bags, a water carrier, &c.
E.
दृति, and हृ to take, अण् aff.
